verses.original: Μετὰ ταῦτα ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης τῆς Τιβεριάδος ὁ Ἰησοῦς πάλιν ἐφανέρωσεν ἑαυτὸν τοῖς μαθηταῖς δὲ ἐφανέρωσεν οὕτως
verses.transliteration: Meta tauta epi tēs thalassēs tēs Tiberiados ho Iēsous palin ephanerōsen heauton tois mathētais de ephanerōsen houtōs
verses.literal: Later . . . by the Sea - of Tiberias - Jesus again revealed Himself to the disciples - He made [Himself] known in this way

verses.original: Σίμων Πέτρος καὶ Θωμᾶς ὁ λεγόμενος Δίδυμος καὶ Ναθαναὴλ ὁ ἀπὸ Κανᾶ τῆς Γαλιλαίας καὶ οἱ τοῦ Ζεβεδαίου καὶ δύο ἄλλοι ἐκ αὐτοῦ τῶν μαθητῶν ἦσαν ὁμοῦ
verses.transliteration: Simōn Petros kai Thōmas ho legomenos Didymos kai Nathanaēl ho apo Kana tēs Galilaias kai hoi tou Zebedaiou kai dyo alloi ek autou tōn mathētōn ēsan homou
verses.literal: Simon Peter - Thomas - called Didymus - Nathanael - from Cana - in Galilee - the [sons] - of Zebedee and two other - - - disciples were together

verses.original: Σίμων Πέτρος λέγει αὐτοῖς Ὑπάγω ἁλιεύειν ἡμεῖς καὶ Ἐρχόμεθα σὺν σοί Λέγουσιν αὐτῷ ἐξῆλθον καὶ ἐνέβησαν εἰς τὸ πλοῖον καὶ ἐπίασαν οὐδέν ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ νυκτὶ
verses.transliteration: Simōn Petros legei autois Hypagō halieuein hēmeis kai Erchometha syn soi Legousin autō exēlthon kai enebēsan eis to ploion kai epiasan ouden en ekeinē tē nykti
verses.literal: Simon Peter told them I am going fishing We vvv will go with you they said - [So] they went out and got into the boat [but] caught nothing - that - night

verses.original: δὲ Πρωΐας ἤδη γενομένης Ἰησοῦς ἔστη εἰς τὸν αἰγιαλόν μέντοι οἱ μαθηταὶ οὐ ᾔδεισαν ὅτι ἐστιν Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: de Prōias ēdē genomenēs Iēsous estē eis ton aigialon mentoi hoi mathētai ou ēdeisan hoti estin Iēsous
verses.literal: - Early in the morning . . . . . . Jesus stood on the shore but the disciples {did} not recognize that it was Jesus

verses.original: οὖν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει αὐτοῖς Παιδία μή ἔχετε τι προσφάγιον Οὔ Ἀπεκρίθησαν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: oun ho Iēsous legei autois Paidia mē echete ti prosphagion Ou Apekrithēsan autō
verses.literal: So - [He] called out to them Children vvv do you have any fish No they answered -

verses.original: δὲ Ὁ εἶπεν αὐτοῖς Βάλετε τὸ δίκτυον εἰς τὰ δεξιὰ μέρη τοῦ πλοίου καὶ εὑρήσετε οὖν ἔβαλον καὶ οὐκέτι ἴσχυον ἑλκύσαι αὐτὸ ἀπὸ τοῦ πλήθους τῶν ἰχθύων
verses.transliteration: de Ho eipen autois Balete to diktyon eis ta dexia merē tou ploiou kai heurēsete oun ebalon kai ouketi ischyon helkysai auto apo tou plēthous tōn ichthyōn
verses.literal: - - He told them Cast the net on the right side of the boat and you will find [some] So they cast [it there] and vvv they were unable to haul it in . . . because of the great number of fish

verses.original: οὖν ἐκεῖνος ὁ μαθητὴς ὃν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἠγάπα Λέγει τῷ Πέτρῳ ἐστιν Ὁ Κύριός οὖν Σίμων Πέτρος ἀκούσας ὅτι ἐστιν ὁ Κύριός διεζώσατο τὸν ἐπενδύτην γὰρ ἦν γυμνός καὶ ἔβαλεν ἑαυτὸν εἰς τὴν θάλασσαν
verses.transliteration: oun ekeinos ho mathētēs hon ho Iēsous ēgapa Legei tō Petrō estin Ho Kyrios oun Simōn Petros akousas hoti estin ho Kyrios diezōsato ton ependytēn gar ēn gymnos kai ebalen heauton eis tēn thalassan
verses.literal: Then [the] - disciple whom - Jesus loved said - to Peter It is the Lord As soon as Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord he put on [his] outer garment (for he had removed it . . . ) and jumped . . . into the sea

verses.original: δὲ οἱ ἄλλοι μαθηταὶ ἦλθον τῷ πλοιαρίῳ σύροντες τὸ δίκτυον τῶν ἰχθύων γὰρ ἦσαν οὐ μακρὰν ἀπὸ τῆς γῆς ἀλλὰ ὡς διακοσίων πηχῶν ἀπὸ
verses.transliteration: de hoi alloi mathētai ēlthon tō ploiariō syrontes to diktyon tōn ichthyōn gar ēsan ou makran apo tēs gēs alla hōs diakosiōn pēchōn apo
verses.literal: - The other disciples came [ashore] in the boat They dragged in the net full of fish for they were not far from - land only about a hundred yards . . . . . .

verses.original: οὖν Ὡς ἀπέβησαν εἰς τὴν γῆν βλέπουσιν ἀνθρακιὰν κειμένην καὶ ὀψάριον ἐπικείμενον καὶ ἄρτον
verses.transliteration: oun Hōs apebēsan eis tēn gēn blepousin anthrakian keimenēn kai opsarion epikeimenon kai arton
verses.literal: - When they landed . . . . . . . . . they saw a charcoal fire there [with] fish on it and [some] bread

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτοῖς Ἐνέγκατε ἀπὸ τῶν ὀψαρίων ὧν νῦν ἐπιάσατε
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autois Enenkate apo tōn opsariōn hōn nyn epiasate
verses.literal: - Jesus told them Bring [some] of the fish - vvv you have just caught

verses.original: οὖν Σίμων Πέτρος ἀνέβη καὶ εἵλκυσεν τὸ δίκτυον εἰς τὴν γῆν μεστὸν μεγάλων ἰχθύων ἑκατὸν πεντήκοντα τριῶν καὶ ὄντων τοσούτων τὸ δίκτυον οὐκ ἐσχίσθη
verses.transliteration: oun Simōn Petros anebē kai heilkysen to diktyon eis tēn gēn meston megalōn ichthyōn hekaton pentēkonta triōn kai ontōn tosoutōn to diktyon ouk eschisthē
verses.literal: So Simon Peter went aboard and dragged the net vvv vvv ashore [It was] full of large fish 153 {} . . . . . . but even with so many the net vvv was not torn

verses.original: Δεῦτε ἀριστήσατε ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτοῖς δὲ οὐδεὶς τῶν μαθητῶν ἐτόλμα ἐξετάσαι αὐτόν τίς εἶ Σὺ εἰδότες ὅτι ἐστιν ὁ Κύριός
verses.transliteration: Deute aristēsate ho Iēsous Legei autois de oudeis tōn mathētōn etolma exetasai auton tis ei Sy eidotes hoti estin ho Kyrios
verses.literal: Come have breakfast - Jesus said to them - None of the disciples dared to ask Him Who are You They knew - it was the Lord

verses.original: Ἰησοῦς ἔρχεται ὁ καὶ λαμβάνει τὸν ἄρτον καὶ δίδωσιν αὐτοῖς καὶ ὁμοίως τὸ ὀψάριον
verses.transliteration: Iēsous erchetai ho kai lambanei ton arton kai didōsin autois kai homoiōs to opsarion
verses.literal: Jesus came - and took the bread and gave [it] to them and [He did] the same with the fish

verses.original: Τοῦτο ἤδη τρίτον Ἰησοῦς ἐφανερώθη ὁ τοῖς μαθηταῖς ἐγερθεὶς ἐκ νεκρῶν
verses.transliteration: Touto ēdē triton Iēsous ephanerōthē ho tois mathētais egertheis ek nekrōn
verses.literal: This [was] now the third time [that] Jesus appeared to the disciples after He was raised from [the] dead

verses.original: οὖν Ὅτε ἠρίστησαν ὁ Ἰησοῦς λέγει Σίμωνι τῷ Πέτρῳ Σίμων Ἰωάννου ἀγαπᾷς με πλέον τούτων Ναί Κύριε Λέγει αὐτῷ σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ Βόσκε μου τὰ ἀρνία
verses.transliteration: oun Hote ēristēsan ho Iēsous legei Simōni tō Petrō Simōn Iōannou agapas me pleon toutōn Nai Kyrie Legei autō sy oidas hoti philō se Legei autō Boske mou ta arnia
verses.literal: vvv When they had finished eating - Jesus asked Simon - Peter Simon [son] of John do you love Me more than these Yes Lord he answered . . . You know - I love You [Jesus] replied . . . Feed My - lambs

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ πάλιν δεύτερον Σίμων Ἰωάννου ἀγαπᾷς με Ναί Κύριε Λέγει αὐτῷ σὺ οἶδας ὅτι φιλῶ σε Λέγει αὐτῷ Ποίμαινε μου τὰ πρόβατά
verses.transliteration: Legei autō palin deuteron Simōn Iōannou agapas me Nai Kyrie Legei autō sy oidas hoti philō se Legei autō Poimaine mou ta probata
verses.literal: [Jesus] asked - vvv a second time Simon [son] of John do you love Me Yes Lord he answered . . . You know - I love You [Jesus] told him Shepherd My - sheep

verses.original: Λέγει αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Σίμων Ἰωάννου φιλεῖς με ὁ Πέτρος Ἐλυπήθη ὅτι εἶπεν αὐτῷ τὸ τρίτον Φιλεῖς με Κύριε σὺ οἶδας πάντα Καὶ εἶπεν αὐτῷ σὺ γινώσκεις ὅτι φιλῶ σε ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῷ Βόσκε μου τὰ πρόβατά
verses.transliteration: Legei autō to triton Simōn Iōannou phileis me ho Petros Elypēthē hoti eipen autō to triton Phileis me Kyrie sy oidas panta Kai eipen autō sy ginōskeis hoti philō se ho Iēsous Legei autō Boske mou ta probata
verses.literal: [Jesus] asked - a third time Simon [son] of John do you love Me - Peter was deeply hurt that [Jesus] had asked him - a third time Do you love Me Lord You know all things - he replied - You know - I love You - Jesus said to him Feed My - sheep

verses.original: Ἀμὴν ἀμὴν λέγω σοι ὅτε ἦς νεώτερος ἐζώννυες σεαυτὸν καὶ περιεπάτεις ὅπου ἤθελες δὲ ὅταν γηράσῃς ἐκτενεῖς σου τὰς χεῖράς καὶ ἄλλος ζώσει σε καὶ οἴσει ὅπου οὐ θέλεις
verses.transliteration: Amēn amēn legō soi hote ēs neōteros ezōnnyes seauton kai periepateis hopou ētheles de hotan gērasēs ekteneis sou tas cheiras kai allos zōsei se kai oisei hopou ou theleis
verses.literal: Truly truly I tell you when you were young you dressed yourself and walked where you wanted but when you are old you will stretch out your - hands and someone else will dress you and lead [you] where vvv you do not want to go

verses.original: δὲ εἶπεν τοῦτο σημαίνων θανάτῳ ποίῳ δοξάσει τὸν Θεόν Καὶ εἰπὼν τοῦτο λέγει αὐτῷ Ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: de eipen touto sēmainōn thanatō poiō doxasei ton Theon Kai eipōn touto legei autō Akolouthei moi
verses.literal: - [Jesus] said this to indicate [the kind of] death by which [Peter] would glorify - God And [after] He had said this He told him Follow Me

verses.original: ὁ Πέτρος Ἐπιστραφεὶς βλέπει τὸν μαθητὴν ὃν ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἠγάπα ἀκολουθοῦντα καὶ ὃς ἀνέπεσεν ἐπὶ αὐτοῦ τὸ στῆθος ἐν τῷ δείπνῳ καὶ εἶπεν Κύριε τίς ἐστιν ὁ παραδιδούς σε
verses.transliteration: ho Petros Epistrapheis blepei ton mathētēn hon ho Iēsous ēgapa akolouthounta kai hos anepesen epi autou to stēthos en tō deipnō kai eipen Kyrie tis estin ho paradidous se
verses.literal: - Peter turned [and] saw the disciple whom - Jesus loved following [them] [He was the one] who had leaned back vvv vvv vvv [against Jesus] at the supper - to ask Lord who is going to . . . betray You

verses.original: οὖν ἰδὼν τοῦτον ὁ Πέτρος λέγει τῷ Ἰησοῦ Κύριε δὲ τί οὗτος
verses.transliteration: oun idōn touton ho Petros legei tō Iēsou Kyrie de ti houtos
verses.literal: [When] [Peter] saw him - [he] asked . . . . . . Lord - what about [him]

verses.original: ὁ Ἰησοῦς Λέγει αὐτῷ Ἐὰν θέλω αὐτὸν μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι τί πρὸς σέ σύ ἀκολούθει μοι
verses.transliteration: ho Iēsous Legei autō Ean thelō auton menein heōs erchomai ti pros se sy akolouthei moi
verses.literal: - Jesus answered . . . If I want him to remain until I return what [is that] to you You follow Me

verses.original: οὖν οὗτος ὁ λόγος ἐξῆλθεν εἰς τοὺς ἀδελφοὺς ὅτι ἐκεῖνος ὁ μαθητὴς οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει δὲ ὁ Ἰησοῦς οὐκ εἶπεν αὐτῷ ὅτι οὐκ ἀποθνήσκει ἀλλ’ Ἐὰν θέλω αὐτὸν μένειν ἕως ἔρχομαι τί πρὸς σέ
verses.transliteration: oun houtos ho logos exēlthen eis tous adelphous hoti ekeinos ho mathētēs ouk apothnēskei de ho Iēsous ouk eipen autō hoti ouk apothnēskei all’ Ean thelō auton menein heōs erchomai ti pros se
verses.literal: Because of this the rumor spread among the brothers that this - disciple {would} not die However - Jesus vvv did not say . . . that vvv he would not die but only If I want him to remain until I return what [is that] to you

verses.original: Οὗτός ἐστιν ὁ μαθητὴς ὁ μαρτυρῶν περὶ τούτων καὶ ὁ γράψας ταῦτα καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι αὐτοῦ ἡ μαρτυρία ἐστίν ἀληθὴς
verses.transliteration: Houtos estin ho mathētēs ho martyrōn peri toutōn kai ho grapsas tauta kai oidamen hoti autou hē martyria estin alēthēs
verses.literal: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who has written [them down] And we know that his - testimony is true

verses.original: δὲ Ἔστιν πολλὰ ἄλλα καὶ ἃ ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐποίησεν ἅτινα ἐὰν καθ’ ἕν γράφηται οἶμαι οὐδ’ τὸν κόσμον αὐτὸν χωρήσειν τὰ βιβλία γραφόμενα
verses.transliteration: de Estin polla alla kai ha ho Iēsous epoiēsen hatina ean kath’ hen graphētai oimai oud’ ton kosmon auton chōrēsein ta biblia graphomena
verses.literal: - There are many more things . . . that - Jesus did - If all of them . . . were written down I suppose that not even the world itself would have space for the books that would be written
